According to a 2018 Business Insider report based on Sinclair's own website, Sinclair also held KUNS (Univision) in the Seattle-Tacoma market at that time [d3]. KOMO-TV is Sinclair's most prominently documented Seattle station, having won a National Edward R. Murrow Award and, as of September 1, 2023, also launching The CW network programming on the station [d4][d7]. A station index source from 2025 also confirms a Sinclair Broadcast Group-owned station in Seattle, WA [d6].
